name: Alekhine's Defense
description: Unlock the Alekhine's Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: Play 1.e4 as White and answer with 1...Nf6 as Black, inviting White's pawns forward so you can attack them later with piece play — a fine practical try if you enjoy provoking overextension.

name: Benko Gambit
description: Unlock the Benko Gambit book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, meet 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 c5 3.d5 with 3...b5, offering a pawn for long-term pressure down the open a- and b-files against White's queenside.

name: Benoni Defense: Modern Variation
description: Unlock the Benoni Defense: Modern Variation book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, play 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 c5 3.d5 e6, aiming to meet d5 with a pawn break and generate dynamic counterplay against White's center rather than equalizing quietly.

name: Bird Opening
description: Unlock the Bird Opening book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, open with 1.f4, staking a claim on e5 and preparing quick kingside development — study the Froms Gambit reply (1...e5) so you're not caught off guard.

name: Bogo-Indian Defense
description: Unlock the Bogo-Indian Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, play 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 Bb4+, a quieter Indian setup that avoids heavy theory while still fighting for the center with pieces.

name: Caro-Kann Defense
description: Unlock the Caro-Kann Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, meet 1.e4 with 1...c6, preparing ...d5 without blocking your light-squared bishop — a solid, low-risk defense favored by players who want fewer forced lines.

name: Catalan Opening
description: Unlock the Catalan Opening book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, combine d4/c4 with an early g3 fianchetto, pressuring Black's queenside and the long diagonal simultaneously — a strategically rich system rather than a sharp trap-based one.

name: Dutch Defense
description: Unlock the Dutch Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, answer 1.d4 with 1...f5, grabbing kingside space early — commit to understanding the resulting king safety trade-offs before playing it in serious games.

name: English Opening
description: Unlock the English Opening book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, open with 1.c4, a flexible flank opening that can transpose into many structures — decide early whether you want a Reversed Sicilian or a symmetrical setup.

name: French Defense
description: Unlock the French Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, meet 1.e4 with 1...e6, preparing ...d5 while accepting a temporarily passive light-squared bishop in exchange for a solid pawn chain.

name: Grob Opening
description: Unlock the Grob Opening book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, play the unconventional 1.g4 — treat it as a surprise weapon against unprepared opponents rather than a mainstream repertoire choice.

name: Grünfeld Defense
description: Unlock the Grünfeld Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, play 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 d5, striking at White's center with a pawn break rather than occupying it directly, then pressuring it with pieces from the fianchetto.

name: Italian Game
description: Unlock the Italian Game book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, play 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4, developing quickly toward f7 — a great opening for beginners to learn tactics and rapid development around a classical center.

name: King's Indian Attack
description: Unlock the King's Indian Attack book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, set up with 1.Nf3, 2.g3, and a kingside fianchetto regardless of Black's reply — the same plan works against nearly anything, which makes it easy to learn once.

name: King's Indian Defense
description: Unlock the King's Indian Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, meet 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 with a kingside fianchetto, letting White build a big center before striking it with ...e5 or ...c5 — a sharp, counterattacking choice.

name: King's Fianchetto Opening
description: Unlock the King's Fianchetto Opening book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, open with 1.g3, developing the bishop to g2 before committing your central pawns — a quiet, flexible move-order that sidesteps a lot of mainstream opening theory.

name: King's Gambit
description: Unlock the King's Gambit book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, play 1.e4 e5 2.f4, offering a pawn to rip open the f-file and center lines for a quick attack — a romantic, high-risk opening best studied with its tactical traps.

name: London System
description: Unlock the London System book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, set up pawns on d4/e3 with the bishop developed to f4 before Black can contest it — a repeatable structure you can play against almost any Black setup.

name: Nimzo-Indian Defense
description: Unlock the Nimzo-Indian Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, play 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4, pinning White's knight immediately to fight for the center with pieces rather than pawns — one of the most respected defenses at every level.

name: Nimzowitsch-Larsen Attack
description: Unlock the Nimzowitsch-Larsen Attack book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, open with 1.b3, fianchettoing the queenside bishop onto the long diagonal aimed at Black's kingside — a hypermodern approach that avoids early pawn commitments.

name: Pirc Defense
description: Unlock the Pirc Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, meet 1.e4 with 1...d6 and 2...Nf6, planning a kingside fianchetto and letting White overextend before striking back at the center — a hypermodern, flexible setup.

name: Polish Opening
description: Unlock the Polish Opening book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, play 1.b4, offering early queenside space and a long-diagonal bishop — mostly a surprise weapon, so know the main independent lines Black can choose against it.

name: Queen's Gambit
description: Unlock the Queen's Gambit book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, play 1.d4 d5 2.c4, offering a flank pawn to lure Black's center pawn away and build a strong classical center — one of the most reliable and well-tested openings in chess.

name: Queen's Indian Defense
description: Unlock the Queen's Indian Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, play 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 b6, fianchettoing the queenside bishop to control the long diagonal and contest e4 — a solid, positional choice against 1.d4.

name: Reti Opening
description: Unlock the Reti Opening book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, open with 1.Nf3, keeping your options flexible before committing your center pawns — useful for players who want to reach a range of different structures from one move order.

name: Scandinavian Defense
description: Unlock the Scandinavian Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, meet 1.e4 with 1...d5, challenging the center immediately — be ready to develop quickly after the queen recapture since you'll spend an early tempo retreating it.

name: Scotch Game
description: Unlock the Scotch Game book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, play 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4, opening the center early to reach open, tactical positions rather than the slower buildup of the Italian or Ruy Lopez.

name: Sicilian Defense
description: Unlock the Sicilian Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, meet 1.e4 with 1...c5, creating immediate asymmetry and fighting for the center from the side rather than mirroring White — the most popular defense to 1.e4 at every level.

name: Sicilian Defense: Alapin Variation
description: Unlock the Sicilian Defense: Alapin Variation book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White against the Sicilian, play 2.c3, preparing to meet ...d5 with a solid center rather than diving into the sharpest Open Sicilian theory — a practical, lower-theory try.

name: Sicilian Defense: Closed Variation
description: Unlock the Sicilian Defense: Closed Variation book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White against the Sicilian, play 2.Nc3 and set up a kingside fianchetto rather than opening the center with an early d4 — a strategic, less forcing approach than the Open Sicilian.

name: Slav Defense
description: Unlock the Slav Defense book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As Black, meet 1.d4 d5 2.c4 with 2...c6, supporting the d5 pawn while keeping the light-squared bishop free — one of the most solid replies to the Queen's Gambit.

name: Spanish Game (Ruy Lopez)
description: Unlock the Spanish Game (Ruy Lopez) book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, play 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5, pressuring the knight that defends e5 — one of the oldest and most deeply analyzed openings, rewarding real study time.

name: Trompowsky Attack
description: Unlock the Trompowsky Attack book by playing games in this opening.
howTo: As White, play 1.d4 Nf6 2.Bg5, immediately pinning or provoking a response from Black's knight before committing to a pawn structure — a low-theory way to sidestep mainstream Indian defenses.
